headlines.headline: BEN SIMMONS TEARS ACHILLES AT PRACTICE, OUT FOR SEASON BEFORE KINGS DEBUT
headlines.detail: Simmons suffered a torn Achilles tendon in practice just days before his first regular-season appearance since 2024-25, ending his Kings season before it started, part of an early-season injury wave that also includes Magic forward Paolo Banchero's high-ankle sprain and Pistons center Jalen Duren's lower-body strain.

headlines.headline: 49ERS' PERFECT SEASON ENDS AS FALCONS UPSET SAN FRANCISCO 29-20
headlines.detail: Atlanta snapped San Francisco's unbeaten start with a 29-20 win as Brock Purdy threw two interceptions, while the Buccaneers (2-5) throttled division-leading Carolina 43-13 behind Baker Mayfield and the Vikings improved to 6-0 by beating Indianapolis 16-10 in Sunday's Week 7 slate.

headlines.headline: MIAMI ROUTS PITT 52-23, HURRICANES REACH NO. 1 FOR FIRST TIME SINCE 2002
headlines.detail: Miami improved to 7-0 (5-0 ACC) behind Darian Mensah's 387 passing yards and four touchdowns and a school-record 16 catches from Malachi Toney, setting up the Hurricanes to open atop the AP poll when the first College Football Playoff rankings drop Nov. 3; BYU remains the sport's only other unbeaten power-conference team.

headlines.headline: FLORIDA OPENS AS CONSENSUS NO. 1 DESPITE OVERTIME LOSS TO BAYLOR IN EXHIBITION
headlines.detail: Florida drew 47 of 59 first-place votes in the AP preseason poll and also topped the Coaches Poll, even after falling to Baylor 82-76 in overtime in its exhibition opener; Duke, Illinois, UConn and Arizona round out the AP top five, with preseason All-American Thomas Haugh leading the Gators into the Nov. 2-3 regular-season tip-off.
